question: \[Now, if the size of \angle VAW is \theta °, find \theta  to two decimal places.\]

answer_verification.verified_answer: 68.34 degrees (using rounded AW=8.49 cm); exact dimensions give 68.35 degrees
answer_verification.issue: The word ?Now? signals dependence on the rounded result from the preceding part. Using AW rounded to 8.49 cm gives 68.34 degrees; using exact AW=12/sqrt(2) gives 68.35 degrees. Preserve raw GT 68.34.
answer_verification.reasoning: cos(theta)=AW/VA. With prior-part rounding: arccos(8.49/23)=68.34 degrees. Without intermediate rounding, arccos((12/sqrt(2))/23)=68.35 degrees. This is a rounding-dependence issue.
